column1: # One data row per case: context<TAB>label<TAB>value<TAB>expected.
# `value` holds only [A-Za-z0-9] and three-digit octal escapes (\ooo):
# % is \045, \ is \134, space is \040, LF is \012, DEL is \177.
# Every byte >= 0x80 is escaped too, so the field is a safe printf
# format and the row survives any file encoding.
# Consumers, each of which fails loud on an unexpected row count:
#   H15 driver in image  every row                   368
#   quoted and bare               ACCEPT except the 13 rows holding
